description.value: Shree Supermarket is a South Asian grocery store specializing in Indian vegetables, fresh fruit, spices, snacks, and pantry staples, aiming to bring authentic Indian flavors to Canadian kitchens. The store operates a Square online storefront offering local delivery of products including basmati rice, fresh produce, and packaged Indian goods. The physical store's exact location is uncertain, as the website URL references Burnaby while the OSM record places it in North Vancouver.
